_comment: Mountain Hardwear pass 2026-09-12 — the catalog had twelve Mountain Hardwear rows; a list in this month's candidate scan typed the Rockrydge Pant. mountainhardwear.com sits behind PerimeterX (curl is redirected to a challenge and the browser was asked to press-and-hold), so the rows come from the maker's own Japanese store, mountainhardwear.jp (Columbia Sportswear Japan), which prints every product's English name, style number, fit and a weight — '重量(g) (目安) 350 g(Mサイズ)' — the same home-market move as Montbell's and Snow Peak's Japanese pages. Garment weights are the size the page names (Medium, or the waist and inseam a pant is listed at, kept in the variant and the length attribute); a Japan-only Asian-fit product says so in its variant, since the same name in the US line is a different cut. Weights without a size (hats, gloves, packs, duffels, bags) are as printed; sleeping bags are the Regular length the store sells with the rating in the name carried as temp_f. Tents, the Direttissima, Scrambler 35, AMG 75, Alakazam and Kazam packs print no weight there and are not added; the Ghoul 20F and the men's Ghost Whisperer Hoody are already cited from the US line and are left alone. Quotes are NFKC-normalised (a full-width ｇ becomes g), figures untouched. The women's Microchill Pullover Crew prints the same 242 g as the men's, which the duplicate check reads as one product twice, so only the men's row is kept.
